register_lr_schedulers: register all LR scheduler types into a fairseq2 DependencyContainer for dependency injection
create_cosine_annealing_lr: create a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler from a CosineAnnealingLRConfig via the dependency resolver
create_noam_lr: create a Noam learning rate scheduler from a NoamLRConfig via the dependency resolver
create_tri_stage_lr: create a tri-stage learning rate scheduler from a TriStageLRConfig via the dependency resolver
create_polynomial_decay_lr: create a polynomial decay learning rate scheduler from a PolynomialDecayLRConfig via the dependency resolver
